reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered redline is identical to the original p0066 with no comment, which is exactly what a compliant finding should produce.

The rule's preferred position is 'No non-solicit on Customer'; the cited independent-contractor clause imposes no hiring restriction and the rationale documents targeted searches showing no non-solicit, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant anywhere, so absence satisfies the preferred position rather than constituting a 'missing' clause (we would not ask the Vendor to insert a covenant against ourselves).

The failed deterministic sub-checks (12-month duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are correctly treated as heuristic artifacts of there being no non-solicit text to measure, not as evidence of a deviation.
No over-flagging or directional error: nothing was redlined against our interest, and the fallback terms are recorded as the negotiating floor if the Vendor later proposes a non-solicit.
